mission: Adversarially critique CONTEXT_FABRIC_ARCHITECTURE_V1 against current information-retrieval/database/software-engineering practice, test whether its hybrid manifest+graph+lexical/vector+compiler design is unnecessarily complex or unsafe, and produce a simpler staged candidate with authority/currentness protections and falsifiers.
acceptance_criteria: current proposal is attacked not restated
revised staged implementation + falsification plan produced

l2_exact_source_refs_opened: live Supabase public table-name read-only inspection
PostgreSQL current Full Text Search documentation
omitted_but_available_refs: Broader vendor RAG framework documentation was not needed because primary database/vector documentation plus repository evidence was sufficient for the challenged implementation choices.
contradictions_surfaced: The long-term hybrid direction is reasonable, but making all four layers required at P1 conflicts with preserve-first/fastest-falsifiable implementation and with the lack of operational Context Fabric evidence.
The architecture says authority/freshness must never be compressed away, while its conceptual weighted utility includes those obligations as score terms; the return converts them to hard constraints.
The independent Context Inventory prototype, inspected after the initial critic attack, independently converges on repository-first deterministic P1 and defers Supabase/vector infrastructure.

checkpoints.evidence: exclusive second claim + STARTED + context receipt persisted
A1-A12 adversarial findings attack premature vector/summaries, weighted safety constraints, graph scope, identity and receipt gaps
current PostgreSQL FTS, upstream pgvector filtering/recall behavior, Supabase hybrid search and live Supabase capability state compared
hard authority/freshness/privacy constraints, stale/hash, path identity, ANN filter recall, embedding drift and cross-root privacy failure modes specified
Context Fabric Lite -> Evidence-Gated Hybrid P0-P5 staged architecture and deterministic query plan defined
CF1-CF14 falsification suite, real queue/read_scope gold benchmark, stop-doing list and candidate next-work proposals persisted in RETURN

result_summary: COMPLETE: adversarial review recommends preserving the long-term hybrid direction but implementing a deterministic repository-first Context Fabric Lite, with vectors/generated summaries gated by measured marginal value. No shared architecture/authority head mutated.
